title: Book 5 — Terpsichore, Chapter 79
paragraphs: So were these faring. The Thebans after this sent to the god, wishing to be avenged on the Athenians. The Pythian priestess, however, said that vengeance was not possible for them by their own strength alone, but told them to report the matter to the “many-voiced” and ask help of those who were “nearest” to them. When those sent to consult the oracle returned, they called a general assembly and reported it; and when the Thebans heard them say that they were to ask help of those who were nearest, they said: “Surely those who live nearest to us are the men of Tanagra, Coroneia, and Thespiae; and these always fight zealously on our side and endure the war with us to the end. What need is there to ask of them? Rather, perhaps, that is not the meaning of the oracle.”
